title: 第751章 全员都在苟谁是苟中苟第750章 各怀鬼胎婴灵夺宝局开启
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
七道流光划破云层，在东荒域的穹顶拉出长长的气浪。
足足飞出八千里之遥，前方的地平线上，一片连绵不绝的黑色山脉如巨兽般匍匐在大地上。
“前方就是苍莽山脉了，大家收敛气息，贴地飞行。”
苏媚的声音在众人耳畔响起。
众人按下遁光，落入茂密的古木林中。
刚一落地，林渊神色不动，心头却暗自计较。
这里的灵气浓郁得几近粘稠，甚至比青阳宗明月峰还要强出三分。
他压下心头对完整天域的遐想，收敛气息，紧随队伍向前推进。
苍莽山脉占地极广，古木参天，毒瘴弥漫，更是高阶妖兽的乐园。
随着众人不断深入，遭遇的妖兽也越来越强。
“嘶——”
毒瘴翻滚，一头体长三丈、背生双翅的紫翼风蜈嘶吼着扑杀而出，三阶后期妖兽的腥风扑面而来。
“我来！”
陈锋与柳轻烟连句废话都没有，两柄长剑同时出鞘。
青红两道剑气在半空首尾相连，化作一张巨大的十字剑网。
“噗嗤”一声闷响，紫翼风蜈那引以为傲的坚硬甲壳如纸糊般被轻易切开，墨绿色的毒血泼洒了一地。
“好精妙的合击剑诀！”
铁山忍不住出声赞叹。
陈锋傲然一笑，收剑入鞘。
这一路杀伐，在场的每个人都在暗中掂量彼此的底细。

铁山与铁石两兄弟手持重型狼牙棒，大开大合，往往能将三阶妖兽生生砸成肉泥；
苏媚则祭出一条火红长鞭，鞭影重重，带着致命的火毒。
唯独化名“杨成”的林渊，显得有些“出工不出力”。
他没动用本命法宝泰阿剑，手里捏着的只是把路边买来的三阶中品飞剑。
面对妖兽，也只是调动金丹大圆满的真元，挥出几道看似寻常的剑气。
但苏媚等人却暗自心惊——这散修出剑角度刁钻至极，次次精准洞穿妖兽死穴，绝对是个刀口舔血的老手。
越往深处，妖气越是骇人。
铁山突然停住脚步，沾满妖血的重型狼牙棒往地上一砸，震出一个土坑。
“苏媚道友，这苍莽山脉再往核心走，可是有未化形的四阶大妖出没的！”
铁山目光灼灼地盯着苏媚，语气不善：
“你为了那几颗婴灵果，要把我们当炮灰使？”
陈锋和柳轻烟也停了下来，手按剑柄，神色警惕。
苏媚转过身，绝美的面容覆着一层寒霜：
“铁山道友这话说得可笑。
“那是元婴前辈的洞府，若建在边缘地带，早被掏空了，还能轮得到我们捡漏？”
铁山脸色一沉：
“那你为何在坊市会合时不明说？
“老子若是早知道，得多备几张保命底牌！”
content_en:
Seven streams of light cut through the clouds, drawing long air waves on the dome of the Eastern Wasteland.
Flying a full eight thousand miles away, on the horizon ahead, there is an endless black mountain range crawling on the earth like a giant beast.
"The vast mountains are ahead. Let's gather our breath and fly close to the ground."
Su Mei's voice rang in everyone's ears.
Everyone pressed the escape light and fell into the dense forest of ancient trees.
As soon as he landed, Lin Yuan's expression remained motionless, but he was secretly thinking about it.
The spiritual energy here is so rich that it is almost viscous, even three points stronger than Qingyang Sect Mingyue Peak.
He suppressed his reverie about the complete heaven, gathered his breath, and followed the team forward.
The Cangmang Mountains cover an extremely large area, with towering ancient trees and poisonous miasma. It is also a paradise for high-level monsters.
As everyone continued to go deeper, the monsters they encountered became stronger and stronger.
"Hiss——"
The poisonous miasma rolled, and a purple-winged wind centipede with a body length of three feet and two wings on its back roared out, and the fishy wind of the late third-level monster hit its face.
"I'll do it!"
Chen Feng and Liu Qingyan didn't even say anything nonsense, and both long swords were unsheathed at the same time.
The two green and red sword energies connected end to end in mid-air, turning into a huge cross sword net.
With a muffled sound of "Puff", the proud hard carapace of the Purple Winged Wind Centipede was cut open as easily as paper, and the dark green poisonous blood was splashed all over the floor.
"What an exquisite joint fencing technique!"
Tieshan couldn't help but praise.
Chen Feng smiled proudly and sheathed his sword.
Along the way, everyone present was secretly weighing each other's background.
The two brothers Tieshan and Tieshi hold heavy maces, which can often smash third-level monsters into pulp with wide open and wide strokes;
Su Mei held out a fiery red whip with heavy shadows and deadly fire poison.
Only Lin Yuan, who goes by the pseudonym "Yang Cheng", seems to be a bit "hardworking".
He did not use the Tai'a sword, his natal magic weapon. What he held in his hand was just a third-level mid-grade flying sword bought on the roadside.
Facing the monsters, he only mobilized the true essence of the Golden Elixir and wielded a few seemingly ordinary sword energy.
But Su Mei and others were secretly frightened - this casual cultivator drew his sword at an extremely cunning angle, accurately piercing the weak points of monsters time and time again. He was definitely an expert at licking blood from the edge of his sword.
The deeper you go, the more terrifying the evil spirit becomes.
Tieshan suddenly stopped and smashed the heavy mace stained with demon blood on the ground, creating a pit.
"Fellow Daoist Su Mei, if you go further to the core of this vast mountain range, there will be untransformed fourth-level monsters appearing!"
Tieshan stared at Su Mei with burning eyes and said in a bad tone:
"Are you going to use us as cannon fodder for those few Infant Spirit Fruits?"
Chen Feng and Liu Qingyan also stopped, pressing their sword hilts with wary expressions.
Su Mei turned around, her beautiful face covered with a layer of frost:
"What Taoist Taoist Master Tieshan said is ridiculous.
"That's Senior Yuanying's cave. If it was built on the fringe, it would have been hollowed out long ago. How can it be our turn to pick it up? "
Tieshan's face darkened:
"Then why didn't you tell me when we met in Fangshi?
"If I had known earlier, I would have prepared a few more life-saving trump cards!"
